decision_target: On the unchanged 18-query, 86-candidate-occurrence DELL/MU/NVDA development projection, rerun the exact local 0.6B baselines and compare them with separately loaded Q4_K_M 4B challengers. Decide only whether the 4B composite challenger merits a fresh natural-candidate-pool experiment.

bound_inputs.purpose: immutable successful acquisition identity and execution authority
only allowed DELL MU NVDA controlled projection
historical 0.6B context only; historical score is not reused as the fair baseline

implementation_bindings.purpose: identity closure, exact official prompt, raw yes-no parser, metric and never-authorize decision compiler

execution_settings.embedding_instruction: Given a source-bound financial research request, retrieve passages that directly address the requested evidence facet while preserving issuer, period and relationship direction.
execution_settings.reranker_instruction: Retrieve source-bound financial passages that directly answer the requested evidence facet. Prefer the correct issuer, reporting period, economic relationship direction, fact state and evidence role; do not treat merely related background as direct evidence.

reranker_surface_decision.reason: The b10516 server advertises /rerank, but the causal-LM Qwen3 path has an open near-zero-score defect; the proposed logit-margin fix was closed without merge and instruction support remains unmerged.
required_checks: server and 0.6B token IDs match for every full prompt
yes and no are each one identical token in both tokenizers
both yes and no appear in raw top_logprobs

baseline_embedding_0_6b.purpose: produce a fair current baseline over exactly the same controlled query and document texts
baseline_embedding_0_6b.input_scale: 18 instructed queries plus each unique document underlying 86 candidate occurrences; maximum observed document 2199 tokens
baseline_embedding_0_6b.required_outputs: normalized vectors, all occurrence scores, DELL/MU/NVDA and overall metrics, token/latency/VRAM receipts
baseline_embedding_0_6b.schema_burden: bound model and tokenizer identity, exact eval digest, deterministic document deduplication and metric rows
baseline_embedding_0_6b.materiality_quality_risk: reusing a historical score or changing query instruction would make the 4B comparison unfair
baseline_embedding_0_6b.comparable_run_evidence: historical 0.6B runtime shadow exists but is intentionally rerun
baseline_embedding_0_6b.stop_and_truncation: batch one, 2560-token ceiling proven above observed maximum, fail on any truncation, omission, CPU fallback or non-finite vector

challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.purpose: test whether the owner-requested larger quantized embedding improves controlled financial evidence ordering
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.input_scale: identical instructed queries and unique documents; every raw token sequence must match the 0.6B tokenizer
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.required_outputs: 2560-dimensional normalized vectors, all occurrence scores, metrics, exact token digests, latency and peak VRAM
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.schema_burden: official GGUF acquisition closure, pinned llama.cpp identity, local HTTP receipt and full GPU-offload proof
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.materiality_quality_risk: runtime, quantization or tokenizer drift could masquerade as a parameter-scale gain
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.reasoning_profile: non-generative embedding through local offline llama.cpp
challenger_embedding_4b_q4_k_m.stop_and_truncation: one input per call, 4096 context, fail on token mismatch, dimension drift, truncation, partial offload, OOM or CPU fallback

baseline_reranker_0_6b.purpose: produce the fair official yes/no logit-margin baseline for all 86 fixed query-document pairs
baseline_reranker_0_6b.input_scale: 86 pairs; maximum observed complete official prompt 2397 tokens and p95 2219
baseline_reranker_0_6b.required_outputs: one yes-minus-no logit score per pair, full controlled metrics, prompt token digest, latency and peak VRAM
baseline_reranker_0_6b.schema_burden: bound causal-LM weights and tokenizer files, exact official prompt and score-order preservation
baseline_reranker_0_6b.materiality_quality_risk: silent longest-first truncation or prompt drift can reverse direct-evidence and hard-negative ordering
baseline_reranker_0_6b.comparable_run_evidence: historical 0.6B controlled pairwise accuracy 0.75 is context only
baseline_reranker_0_6b.stop_and_truncation: batch one, 2560 tokens, fail before scoring if any full prompt exceeds budget or CUDA is unavailable

challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.purpose: test the larger 4B Q4_K_M causal reranker on the identical prompt token arrays
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.input_scale: 86 exact token arrays, one generated token and up to 512 raw top log probabilities per pair
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.required_outputs: raw yes/no log probabilities, their margin, generated token, tokens evaluated, all pair scores and metrics, latency and peak VRAM
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.schema_burden: community quant closure, pinned completion endpoint behavior, per-prompt tokenizer equality and server log receipt
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.materiality_quality_risk: the community quant is not official FP16; the advertised direct rerank endpoint is defective for causal Qwen3 and could produce false near-zero metrics
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.comparable_run_evidence: same-attempt official 0.6B FP16 logit-margin baseline plus public llama.cpp defect receipts
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.reasoning_profile: bounded one-token completion used only to expose raw yes/no logits; free-form generation forbidden
challenger_reranker_4b_q4_k_m.stop_and_truncation: temperature -1, cache disabled, exactly one token, fail if yes/no is missing, token counts drift, truncated is true, full GPU offload is unproved, OOM occurs or CPU fallback is attempted

known_boundary: This compares a current 0.6B FP16 Transformers baseline with a 4B Q4_K_M llama.cpp composite challenger over a labeled fixed pool. It cannot isolate parameter count from quantization/runtime effects. The reranker quant is community-produced. Passing proves neither natural candidate recall nor inner/outer source completeness, and cannot close DELL gaps, qualify S1, or promote a runtime.
